answer: The pearl cap is upheld at intake and jade shows the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a dawn tag. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. Slashing removes 78 percent at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
